name: set_entry_group_iam_policy
description:
Replaces the IAM policy on an Entry Group or Context Set to share or update permissions.

IMPORTANT: Always call `get_entry_group_iam_policy` first, preserve all existing `bindings` (such as `roles/dataplex.entryGroupOwner`), merge in the new or updated binding, and pass the `etag` returned by `get_entry_group_iam_policy`.

IamBinding.description: Represents an IAM role binding on an Entry Group or Context Set.

members.description: Required. Principals receiving the role (`user:{email}`, `group:{email}`, `serviceAccount:{email}`, or `domain:{domain}`).

role.description: Required. IAM role to grant on the Entry Group or Context Set, for example: - Discover Context Set metadata: `roles/dataplex.contextSetViewer` (or `roles/dataplex.entryGroupViewer`) - Consume/read member entries in Context Set: `roles/dataplex.contextSetConsumer` (or `roles/dataplex.catalogViewer`) - Edit entries in Context Set: `roles/dataplex.catalogEditor` - Full owner/admin (including sharing): `roles/dataplex.entryGroupOwner`

bindings.description: Required. Full list of IAM role bindings for the Entry Group or Context Set. MUST include all existing bindings returned by `get_entry_group_iam_policy` (such as `roles/dataplex.entryGroupOwner`) in addition to any added or modified bindings.

entryGroupId.description: Required. ID of the Entry Group or Context Set.

etag.description: Required. The `etag` returned by `get_entry_group_iam_policy` for optimistic concurrency control.

location.description: Required. Location of the Entry Group or Context Set (for example, `us-central1` or `global`).

projectId.description: Required. Project ID containing the Entry Group or Context Set.
